title: A survey detection channel overrides the pixels in an astronomical foundation model, and biases tomographic mean redshifts
abstract: arXiv:2608.23626v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Foundation models for astronomy are trained on survey pixels together with the catalogue products derived from those pixels. Those catalogues are incomplete at a measurable rate, and a model trained on both inherits that incompleteness as a systematic. We audit AION-1, a 39-modality transformer trained on more than 200 million objects, using causal interventions on its inputs.   Holding the image tokens byte-identical and editing only the survey segmentation map changes every quantity the model reports -- flux, size, ellipticity, redshift -- by 110-4400 times a matched placebo. The mechanism is detection gating, presence at the field centre (r = 0.47), not the light the mask encloses (r = 0.30); across 322 real blends the model ignores how the pipeline partitioned the light (R = -0.006). Nor is the preference specific to that channel: contradicted catalogue photometry leaves the model nine times worse than supplying no metadata at all.

translated_title: 一项调查检测通道覆盖了天文基础模型中的像素，并偏置了层析红移平均值
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.23626v1 公告类型：新 摘要：用于天文学的基础模型是在调查像素以及由这些像素衍生的目录产品上训练的。这些目录以可测量的速率存在不完整性，而同时在这两者上训练的模型会将这种不完整性继承为系统性偏差。我们对AION-1进行审计，这是一个在超过2亿个对象上训练的39模态变换器，通过对输入进行因果干预。保持图像令牌字节不变，仅编辑调查分割图，模型报告的每个量——通量、大小、椭圆率、红移——都会比匹配的安慰剂改变110到4400倍。其机制是检测门控，即场中心的存在（r = 0.47），而非掩模包围的光（r = 0.30）；在322个真实混合体上，模型忽略了管道如何分配光（R = -0.006）。这种偏好也不是该通道特有的：矛盾的目录测光使模型比完全不提供元数据时差九倍。
tldr: 该研究发现，天文基础模型AION-1对调查分割图中的检测门控信息异常敏感，这导致其输出（如红移）产生严重偏差，且这种偏差源于检测存在而非实际光分布，揭示了模型对目录不完整性的继承性系统性错误。
en_tdlr: This study reveals that the astronomical foundation model AION-1 is highly sensitive to detection gating in survey segmentation maps, causing severe biases in outputs like redshifts, driven by detection presence rather than actual light distribution, exposing inherited systematic incompleteness from catalogues.
